paper_title: Search for Axions in Magnetic White Dwarf Polarization at Lick and Keck Observatories
coupling_convention: |g_agamma| in GeV^-1, 95% CL one-sided upper limit
notes: Astrophysical (non-DM) constraint from axion-induced linear polarization of magnetic white dwarf starlight, observed with Lick/Kast and Keck/LRISp-ADC. Headline limit |g_agamma| < 1.7e-12 GeV^-1 (95% CL) from SDSS J033320+000720, approximately mass-independent for m_a << 1e-6 eV; encoded as a flat bound spanning the Fig. 1 plot range low end (1e-14 eV) up to the stated validity m_a ~ 2e-7 eV. Limit degrades at higher masses (curve in Fig. 1 not tabulated numerically). Other MWDs give weaker limits (4.2e-12, 5.7e-12, 1.0e-11, 1.6e-11 GeV^-1). No DM density assumption since the signal is photon-to-axion conversion of starlight, not DM conversion. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.85, 45)) | Vision: Main exclusion plot is Fig. 1 (page 1); red solid curve is the most constraining new limit from Lick observation of SDSS J033320+000720.
